sentences.en: I like Brazil, but nevertheless I'm going to the Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢巴西，但无论如何我还是要去乌克兰。

sentences.en: His explanation made no sense, nevertheless, everyone pretended to understand.
sentences.zh: 他的解释毫无道理，然而大家还是假装理解了。

sentences.en: Your explanation made no sense, nevertheless, everyone pretended to listen.
sentences.zh: 你的解释毫无意义，不过大家还是装作在听。

senses.zh: 仍然, 然而, 不过
